columns.name: film_id
columns.description: The unique identifier of the film.

columns.name: length
columns.description: Duration time of the film screening.

columns.name: num_rented_times
columns.description: The number of times the film has been rented, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: rental_revenue
columns.description: The total rental revenue of the film, replace NULL values with 0. Calculate the revenue using the amount received in the payment table.

columns.name: has_a_rental_rate_greater_than_the_60per_of_average_rental_rate_of_all_listed_films
columns.description: Set to 1 if the rental rate of the film is greater than 60% of the average rental rate of all listed films, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: num_actors
columns.description: The number of actors in the film, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: customers_can_rent_for_more_than_5_days
columns.description: Set to 1 if customers can rent the film for more than 5 days, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: The unique identifier of the customer.

columns.name: full_name
columns.description: The full name of the customer, concatenate the first name and last name with a space separating them.

columns.name: has_rented_the_film_with_the_highest_replacement_cost
columns.description: Set to 1 if the customer has rented the film with the highest replacement cost, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: num_rented_films
columns.description: The number of films the customer has rented, replace NULL values with 0. If the customer rents the same film multiple times, count each rental.

columns.name: per_music_film_among_all_rented_films
columns.description: The percentage of music films among all the films the customer has rented. If the customer rents the same film multiple times, count each rental.

columns.name: avg_amount_of_money_spent_on_rental
columns.description: The average amount of money on a single film rental the customer has spent, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: total_payments_greater_than_70per_of_the_average_total_payments
columns.description: Set to 1 if the total payments of the customer is greater than 70% of the average total payments of all customers, 0 otherwise.
